## Findings
- claim-1: For a bigrassmannian \(v\), with \(i,j,a,b\) as specified, \(J_v\subset\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is minimally generated by \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]
- claim-2: The minimal homogeneous generating family above has degree-enumerator \[ \sum_{\mu}q^{|\mu|} =q^{ij}\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}q^{|\rho|} =q^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_q. \] Consequently it has exactly \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements, with exactly \([q^k]\binom{a+b}{a}_q\) generators in partition-weight degree \(ij+k\).
- claim-3: The formula includes \(a=0\): the family is the singleton \(\{\bar s_{i^j}\}\), and its enumerator is \(q^{ij}\).
## Strategy
The requested new consequence is established: the source-minimal family has graded enumerator
\[
\sum_{\mu}z^{|\mu|}
=z^{ij}\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|}
=z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_{z}.
\]
Indeed, \(\mu\mapsto\rho\), where \(\mu=(i^j,\rho)\), bijects
\[
\{\,\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\,\}
\longleftrightarrow\{\rho:\rho\subseteq b^a\}.
\]
Thus \(|\mu|=ij+|\rho|\). With
\[
\binom{a+b}{a}_z:=\prod_{u=1}^{a}\frac{1-z^{b+u}}{1-z^u},
\]
the standard partition recurrence (split by whether \(\rho_1<b\) or \(\rho_1=b\)) gives
\[
\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|}=\binom{a+b}{a}_z.
\]
Consequently there are \([z^k]\binom{a+b}{a}_z\) generators in partition-weight \(ij+k\), and \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) total generators. This refines the source-backed minimality theorem without asserting anything about other minimal families.

For \(a=0\), the rectangle is empty, so the family is the singleton \(\{\bar s_{i^j}\}\), with enumerator \(z^{ij}\).

## Gaps
No gap for this enumerative consequence. It does not claim that every minimal generating family has the same degree distribution.
